name: Safari jeep
short: An open-top 4x4 for game drives in Yala, Udawalawe, Minneriya and Wilpattu.
summary: An open-top 4x4 with a park-registered driver and tracker, booked for morning, afternoon or full-day game drives.

features.title: Registered for the parks
features.body: Only registered jeeps may drive the park tracks. We book drivers we know, who keep a respectful distance from the animals.

features.title: A private jeep, not a shared one
features.body: Your party has the jeep to itself, so you choose when to wait and when to move on.

features.title: Timed to the light
features.body: Morning drives leave before dawn, when the animals are moving. Full days include a packed breakfast and lunch.

included: Bottled water and a packed breakfast on morning drives

questions.q: Can our own driver take us into the park?
questions.a: No. Park rules allow only registered safari jeeps on the tracks. Your driver waits at the gate and takes you on afterwards.
Mornings are cooler and usually busier with animals. Afternoons have softer light for photographs. A full day gives you both.
